articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, the Company reported Net Income of $19.4 million, or $0.25 per diluted share, and $6.0 million, or $0.08 per diluted share, respectively. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, the Company reported Net Income of $26.0 million, or $0.33 per diluted share, and $108.8 million, or $1.39 per diluted share, respectively.
